pulse.notes: The farewell season reaches its final regular season curtain call as the As play host to the NL's top team in the Rockies. As Vinnie Keane HOF career comes to its close a legacy that reshaped Oakland stands to honor it. Manager Deacon Seymour in his rookie campaign appeared to call all the right shots as the As rewrote the history books with the most single wins in a season finishing 127-35. Seymo
